we have developed a simple and efficient method of estimating a dispersion matrix of a bivariate normal population using a small amount of data, and we have shown that our method performs better than other methods in most cases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple estimator of the dispersion matrix is often the best one to use, especially if the sample size is small.
, in many cases, a simple estimator of a parameter can perform as well as a complicated estimator.
